features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 112, p. 342 (also data block 'Cisterns: 1'; fig. 222 p. 343)
features.quote: Close to the large courtyard were found rock-cut installations, a cistern

date.basis: not dated by the entry (site period list does not date the component)

notes: One cistern (text and data block 'Cisterns: 1' = same feature). Text places it only 'close to the large courtyard' (no direction). Plan fig. 222 (north arrow points page-left) shows the cistern roughly west of complex 1, but the unit's 100-m grid point cannot be placed on a ~130 m site plan, so position 'none'. Rock-cut 'installations' not coded (type not stated). Walls 'perhaps serving as dams' are not pools.
